_about: Public-domain Franz Delitzsch (1813-1890), Lutheran Hebraist of Erlangen and Leipzig, for the Word Hoard: his volumes of the Keil and Delitzsch Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament (Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah), his Commentary on Hebrews, A New Commentary on Genesis, A System of Biblical Psychology, Messianic Prophecies (1880 and 1891), Old Testament History of Redemption, Jewish Artisan Life, A Day in Capernaum and Iris, in their nineteenth-century English translations, from Internet Archive scans. Keil's volumes of the same series are on the carl-friedrich-keil shelf. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 48 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
